## ZhRedundancy (Redundant repetition)

- Kind: `Repetition`
- Description: Redundant repetition such as 的的, 了了, 非常非常非常.
- Data: [`harper-zh/data/redundancy.json`](../../harper-zh/data/redundancy.json)

| Incorrect | Suggestion | Message |
|-----------|------------|----------|
| `的的` | `的` | Redundant repetition: consecutive “的”. |
| `了了` | `了` | Redundant repetition: consecutive “了”. |
| `是是` | `是` | Redundant repetition: consecutive “是”. |
| `的话的话` | `的话` | Redundant repetition: use “的话”. |
| `非常非常非常` | `非常` | Over-repeated intensifier: prefer “非常”. |
| `必须须` | `必须` | Repeated character(s): use “必须”. |
| `需需要` | `需要` | Repeated character(s): use “需要”. |
| `进行进行` | `进行` | Redundant repetition: use “进行”. |
| `可以可以` | `可以` | Redundant repetition: use “可以”. |
| `应该应该` | `应该` | Redundant repetition: use “应该”. |
| `已经已经` | `已经` | Redundant repetition: use “已经”. |
| `因为因为` | `因为` | Redundant repetition: use “因为”. |
| `所以所以` | `所以` | Redundant repetition: use “所以”. |
| `但是但是` | `但是` | Redundant repetition: use “但是”. |
| `然后然后` | `然后` | Redundant repetition: use “然后”. |
| `继续继续` | `继续` | Redundant repetition: use “继续”. |
| `开始开始` | `开始` | Redundant repetition: use “开始”. |
| `结束结束` | `结束` | Redundant repetition: use “结束”. |
| `很多很多很多` | `很多` | Over-repeated intensifier: prefer “很多”. |
| `特别特别特别` | `特别` | Over-repeated intensifier: prefer “特别”. |
| `十分十分` | `十分` | Over-repeated intensifier: prefer “十分”. |
